svg.title: D4Drive entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Eight tables. users places bookings, holds refresh_tokens, and acts in booking_status_log. branches houses cars and is the collection point of deliveries. cars is booked in bookings. bookings has one delivery, is paid by payments, and logs booking_status_log.
svg.text: PK primary key, FK foreign key (carmine), UQ unique. Bar: one. Circle: zero. Three prongs: many. Generated from database/schema.sql by npm run build:erd.
